raw.question: Flag mixed-provider bulk dead-letter filtering during disconnect
raw.chosen: Flag mixed-provider bulk dead-letter filtering during disconnect
raw.reasoning: Bulk failure records join paths with commas; provider preflight treats the joined value as one path, so a provider appearing after the first path is not detected and its mirror can be deleted despite pending dead-letter work.

retrospective.summary: Reviewed scoped multi-path CLI operator changes; identified provider disconnect data-loss gap for mixed-provider bulk dead letters.
